method.name: max_disagree_early_scale
method.time_sampler_note: Power-law bias toward early scales: t ~ U(0,1)^2.5, concentrating ~50% of mass on scales 0-2 (t<0.3). More relevant to one-step generation which starts from pure noise.
method.train_notes: Hard-example proposal selection: pick the teacher proposal with maximum LPIPS distance from the initialized student in each group. 256 samples x 4 proposals = 1024 generated, 256 selected. Uniform weighting.

embedding_loss: LPIPS-alex-v0.1 on decoded continuous-head suffix and teacher prefix
classification_loss: CE averaged over generated tokens of all scales
teacher_reuse_note: Each pass visits every pair once; stop earlier when the GPU budget ends.
